# What does your iOS app earn after Apple's cut, and where?

> Free analyzer for iOS developers: drop in your App Store Connect Summary Sales report and see net proceeds by product, country and month, refund rates, subscription renewals, and whether you show the Small Business Program rate. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
